correctness.rationale: The joint-limit theorem follows directly from the exact AR(1) phase equation, has a unique limiting root, and its eigenvector/eigenvalue limits and first-row distance were checked against direct covariance diagonalization.

originality.rationale: Classical finite-N KLT formulas, the DCT endpoint, and continuous exponential-kernel Robin modes are excluded. The claim is restricted to the N(1-rho) joint-limit criterion, explicit DCT-distance obstruction, noncommuting limits, and nonuniformity of the recent correction-factor identity limit; no equivalent source-specific statement was located.

value.rationale: The result turns the qualitative high-correlation DCT heuristic into a sharp block-length-dependent criterion and shows when exact fast KLT corrections remain macroscopically necessary despite rho tending to one.
